items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the centralizer of the tensor product of two subalgebras as the tensor product of the two centralizers (statement lines 394-399). The proof is a complete argument: one inclusion is immediate, and for the converse an element commuting with the tensor product of the subalgebras is shown to commute with each subalgebra tensored with the identity, which puts it in two standard subspaces of the tensor product whose intersection is the tensor product of the centralizers (proof lines 401-406). The non-formal content is the identification of that intersection. The claim is H2.
